claims.disproof_condition: 條件：表後燃氣電廠的許可、整合商申報或客戶文件普遍寫明不配 BESS（只靠機組本身處理負載擺動），或 ProPetro 之後的申報寫出 60 MW 案改成不含電池。核查頻率：每季。觸發後 48 小時：重讀 BESS 是必需層還是選配層，調整這條邊與反向路徑的 confidence。
claims.statement: INNIO (S-1/A, 2026-05-26) claims its Jenbacher engines manage dynamic load swings of 25–40% without extensive battery buffering and reduce the need for batteries or supercapacitors — a supplier claim that engine design can partly substitute for BESS in onsite data center power. It is the engine maker's own claim; ProPetro's 60 MW design still pairs reciprocating engines with BESS, so substitution is partial and unproven by customer documents.

source_doc.title: INNIO S-1/A（2026-05-26）：Jenbacher 引擎可處理 25–40% 動態負載擺動、不需大量電池緩衝；精簡電力架構、減少電池或超級電容等輔助設施

sources.quote: By streamlining the power architecture, our solutions reduce the need for costly auxiliary infrastructure, such as batteries or supercapacitors, thereby driving higher total capex efficiency.

These engines achieve start-to-first-load in approximately 15 seconds for backup operation and can manage dynamic load swings of 25-40% without requiring extensive battery buffering, all while maintaining strict power quality tolerances, a key value requirement for AI training and inferencing data center workloads.
